question: How does stringing the same flowers into a garland affect the merit obtained?
premises: The same flowers may be offered strung as a garland.
Individually offered flowers already yield a defined merit.
Garlanded offerings are assigned a different merit value.
inference: When those same flowers are offered as a garland, one obtains double the merit.
plain_english: When those same flowers are strung into a garland, one obtains double the fruit.
